Name: Lander
Blurb: Your first foothold on Mars. Trickles power, relays every order you give to the fleet, and slowly recharges robots when no Charging Pad is working.
Notes: Pre-placed root node; trickle gen; starter storage; uplink

Name: SolarArray
Blurb: Free power while the sun is up. Output falls at night and in dust storms - pair it with battery banks.
Notes: Flat-pack deploy; yield ~2300 Wh/sol via diurnal curve x DustFactor

Name: BatteryBank
Blurb: Stores power for the night and for storms. Build these before the dark catches you short.
Notes: 1000 W max charge/discharge; ~1 night of baseline per bank

Name: Pylon
Blurb: Extends the power grid. Auto-links the nearest node within range; its disc is your territory.
Notes: Auto-links nearest node in 80 m; cable mesh auto-laid; coverage disc = territory

Name: ChargePad
Blurb: Where robots refuel - fast, one at a time. Without one, they limp home to the Lander, which charges them slowly.
Notes: 500 W transfer to docked robot; robots recharge only here; sheds last

Name: Forge
Blurb: Smelts regolith and ore into structural materials - the stuff nearly everything is built from.
Notes: Milestone structure; batch smelter; sheds first

Name: IceDrill
Blurb: Drills subsurface ice. Must sit on an ice deposit. The first link of the water chain.
Notes: Must sit on Ice deposit; 40 kg ice/h

Name: WaterPlant
Blurb: Melts ice into water for the crew, the garden, and the electrolyzer. Fresh melt restores water quality.
Notes: Melts ice; 50 ice -> 45 water per h

Name: Electrolyzer
Blurb: Splits water into breathable oxygen and hydrogen fuel. A power hog by design - feed it well.
Notes: 10 water -> 8.9 O2 + 1.1 H2 per h; power hog by design

Name: Stockpile
Blurb: Open storage for mined and fabricated solids.
Notes: 2000 kg solid storage

Name: ComputeModule
Blurb: A Lander upgrade that shortens your command lag - the colony's first step toward autonomy.
Notes: Lander upgrade slot; lag 45->20 s; 3.6 kWh/sol -- autonomy has a power price

Name: Habitat
Blurb: A prefab two-bay Living Quarters, assembled from two Forge-made habitat segments (Struct and Shielding). Joins a habitat network like any shell; set an Air Filtration Station inside. (PLACEHOLDER copy, director review)
Notes: BM-1b (2026-10-16, ruling 2a): the prefab - a fixed 1x2-bay pressurized shell whose bays are Living Quarters; bill HabSegment:2 (no surface Shielding tax: the segments carry theirs); 240 s to assemble. Balance placeholder

Name: Borer
Blurb: Digs the shaft and carves out habitat floors through solid rock. Click it to order it to bore deeper or excavate new cells.
Notes: M1-d: works bore/carve designations batch by batch; heavy draw, sheds early; burns H2 (1.5 kg/sol-h, whole batch up-front) instead of grid when stocked - and runs through brownouts

Name: AirFilter
Blurb: Circulates and pressurizes a dug floor's air - the last step that turns a bored-out cavity into a livable vault.
Notes: M1-d Gate B: circulates a floor's air - the habitability chain's last link; life support sheds late (priority 8); M2 habitat vision wants these THROUGHOUT

Name: HumidityRegulator
Blurb: Holds a greenhouse floor's climate at its setting. Without one, Humid and Arid settings wait, inert.
Notes: DORMANT agri Gate B: required online on a floor for non-Temperate climate to take effect; art generated (humidity.glb)

Name: Floodmast
Blurb: A light tower. Costs power and does nothing for survival - it is how a colony stops being a worksite and starts being a place someone lives.
Notes: Surface/floor light: presentation attaches a point light for this DefName; rides bPowered so a brownout darkens the city. LoadPriority 12 = shed first.

Name: LabModule
Blurb: A full laboratory in a prefab shell: two research seats at double yield. Place it on a dug, livable floor once research opens the Full Laboratory.
Notes: Tiered production T1 (2026-10-15): the prefab LabFull station - a building that counts as one LabFull cell when built, powered and on a rated floor. Numbers placeholder, director review.

Name: InfirmaryModule
Blurb: A sick bay in a prefab shell. While it runs, a colonist who loses life support gets an extra sol for the fault to be fixed. Place it on a dug, livable floor.
Notes: Tiered production T1 (2026-10-15): the prefab Infirmary station (counts as an Infirmary cell). Wording is a Gate-D placeholder; numbers placeholder.

Name: GreenhouseDome
Blurb: A glass dome over garden beds. Drag to size it - each 10 m bed is glazed and planted on its own once Glass, Soil and Seeds are in stock, and grows by daylight with no grow-light power.
Notes: Agri Gate C (2026-10-15): the above-ground greenhouse. One bed = one 10 m footprint = one underground Greenhouse cell (soil, seeds, glass, water, yield); the bill and build time scale with beds. Placeholder numbers, director review.

Name: HabModule
Blurb: A pressurized habitat shell. Drag to size it in 10 m bays; zone each bay as a room, and set an Air Filtration Station inside to circulate it. (PLACEHOLDER copy, director review)
Notes: BM-1 (2026-10-16): drag-sized pressurized shell; one bay = 10 m = footprint 5x5; bill and build time per bay (Struct 200 + surface Shielding 50 via GetBuildCostFor); bays centre on the world 10 m grid; power 0 = shell, life support is the AirFilter's draw. Balance placeholder

Name: HabCorridor
Blurb: A one-bay-wide pressurized corridor that joins habitat modules into one network. Its bays are hallways. (PLACEHOLDER copy, director review)
Notes: BM-1 (2026-10-16): drag-sized pressurized corridor, short side capped at 1 bay; bays fixed Hallway (count toward the 4-bay minimum, partition adjacency); cheaper per bay. Balance placeholder
